name: Polynomial Roots Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicitly listed orthogonal vectors with a fully expanded symmetric polynomial that mathematically evaluates to the exact same edge scores (4 for equal, 0 for unequal) on the domain {1, 2, 3}. This hides the discrete equality-check logic behind an algebraic function, forcing models to either evaluate the formula over the domain to discover the 3-coloring reduction (genuine reasoning) or fail via TLE on unpruned backtracking or non-linear SMT queries.
